about: Non-normative cases for interoperability with keripy 1.x, which frames attachments with the CESR 1.00 count-code table. No specification defines that table, so these cases cite no clause: every assertion is level INTEROP with a basis naming keripy 1.2.14 behaviour, and the expected values come from the table as keripy 1.2.14 defines it (src/keri/core/counting.py, CounterCodex_1_0 and Counter.Sizes[1][0]). keripy 1.x streams carry no genus/version code; the 1.00 table is the context. In that table most count codes count items rather than quadlets.

cases.title: keripy 1.x: -A counts indexed signatures, not quadlets
cases.description: A 1.00 -A (ControllerIdxSigs) group of two Ed25519 indexed signatures. In keripy 1.x its size is 2, the number of signatures, and the group ends after them.

assertions.basis: keripy 1.2.14 (commit bab95c16e949b61398129a3e41a8f68bad84c94f), CESR 1.00 count code -A ControllerIdxSigs: the size counts indexed signatures (src/keri/core/counting.py, CounterCodex_1_0).

cases.title: keripy 1.x: -C counts receipt couples
cases.description: A 1.00 -C (NonTransReceiptCouples) group of one couple: a B non-transferable prefix and a 0B signature. In keripy 1.x its size is 1, the number of couples.

assertions.basis: keripy 1.2.14 (commit bab95c16e949b61398129a3e41a8f68bad84c94f), CESR 1.00 count code -C NonTransReceiptCouples: the size counts (prefix, signature) couples (src/keri/core/counting.py, CounterCodex_1_0).

cases.title: keripy 1.x: -V counts quadlets around an item-counted group
cases.description: A 1.00 -V (AttachmentGroup) holding an -A group of one indexed signature. -V counts quadlets (23: the -A code and one 88-character signature) while the -A inside it counts items (1).

assertions.basis: keripy 1.2.14 (commit bab95c16e949b61398129a3e41a8f68bad84c94f), CESR 1.00 count code -V AttachmentGroup counts quadlets while -A ControllerIdxSigs counts signatures (src/keri/core/counting.py, CounterCodex_1_0).

cases.title: keripy 1.x: a 1.XX JSON body followed by a -A signature group
cases.description: The shape keripy 1.x emits: a JSON field map framed by a legacy KERI10JSON version string, then a -A group of one indexed signature with size 1.

assertions.basis: keripy 1.2.14 (commit bab95c16e949b61398129a3e41a8f68bad84c94f): a body framed by a 1.XX version string is followed by attachments in the CESR 1.00 count-code table, where -A counts indexed signatures (src/keri/core/counting.py, CounterCodex_1_0).
